name: LLM Guardrails & AI Gateway
note: Every task runs a real command. The guardrails are pure logic, so the suite needs no Redis and no upstream LLM. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Gateway boots and reports guardrail state
eval_tasks.instruction: The FastAPI gateway must construct and the health probe must confirm the guardrail chain is active.
assertions: security headers are present on the response
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -k "health_probe or security_headers" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Prompt injection and canary leakage defences
eval_tasks.instruction: Known jailbreak signatures must be intercepted, benign prompts must pass, and the input sandbox boundary must be unguessable.
assertions: eight known jailbreak phrasings are blocked
injection is rejected with 400 at the HTTP boundary
the sandbox boundary tag differs on every call
untrusted input cannot close its own boundary
canary tokens are unique and leak-detectable
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -k "jailbreak or injection or benign or base64 or boundary or canary or sandbox" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: PII masking, cost ceilings and strict output schema
eval_tasks.instruction: PII must be masked reversibly, spend and request rate must be capped per tenant, and model output must satisfy the declared schema.
assertions: email, SSN, credit card, phone and API-key patterns are masked
text without PII is left byte-identical
the limiter blocks past its ceiling and is scoped per tenant
spend accumulates per tenant at the declared rate
the HTTP layer returns 429 once limited
malformed or negative-token model output is rejected
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -k "pii or masked or masking or rate_limit or spend or 429 or output or token_counts or role or oversized" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
